# Font Test Fixture — License

`Barlow-Regular.ttf` (147 KB) is downloaded verbatim from the Barlow project
(https://github.com/jpt/barlow).

## License

Barlow is licensed under the **SIL Open Font License 1.1**

https://github.com/jpt/barlow/blob/master/OFL.txt for the full license text.

The font is used solely as a test fixture for the cn-font-split WASM slicing
pipeline — a small Latin TTF that is version-controlled in this repo, so the
test works on any machine (including CI) without local font files. It is not
distributed as part of the application's runtime assets.
